title: 3D MODELING
description: High-poly & low-poly assets built with clean topology and proper UV mapping for any engine.
body: Crafting high-precision 3D models with clean edge loops, optimized quad topology, custom UV unwrap, and industry-standard PBR materials (Albedo, Normal, Roughness, Metallic, Ambient Occlusion). Perfect for real-time video game engines, AAA asset libraries, visual effects, and architectural visualization.
benefits: Optimized draw-calls and performance in Unreal Engine / Unity
Engine-ready collision meshes and LODs (Level of Detail)

process.desc: Analyze reference orthographics, scale requirements, and polycount targets.
Sculpt fine surface details, micro-creases, hard-surface bevels, and anatomical proportions.
Optimize quad geometry and unwrap efficient UV islands with minimal distortion.
Bake normal/AO maps and apply realistic procedural materials in Substance Painter.

deliverables: Substance Painter / Blender Native Source Files

tech.name: Blender
tech.tooltip: Industry-leading 3D modeling, animation, rendering, rigging, and asset creation software.

tech.name: ZBrush
tech.tooltip: The standard for digital sculpting, creating high-poly organic models and characters.

tech.tooltip: Industry standard tool for 3D painting and PBR material authoring.
